newsitem.title: GERMANY: Degussa plans join venture with Cargill.
newsitem.headline: Degussa plans join venture with Cargill.

text.p: German metals and chemicals firm Degussa AG said on Tuesday it had signed a letter of intent to form a joint venture with U.S. firm Cargill to build a new plant for the production of lysine.
Degussa said the plant would be built in Blair, Nebraska, adjacent to Cargill's corn wet milling complex, and would start production in the second half of 1999.
The factory would have the capacity to produce 75,000 tonnes a year of Biolysr, a premium form of feed grade lysine manfactured by Degussa, the German firm said in a statement.
"The new plant will be funded equally by both partners and each company will bring disinct contributions to the joint venture," Degussa said.
It said Cargill would provide corn derived raw materials and infrastructure services for the production process.
